rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user by matching full name and zip code to a single account (Noah Ito, 98187). However, the final information provided included unsupported details: it stated a specific total amount paid ($829.43) seemingly by summing item prices without confirming taxes, shipping, or discounts from the order record (the tool output was truncated and showed no total). It also asserted the payment method used (“charged to your Mastercard ending in 1065”) based only on the stored payment method, not on the order’s payment record. These constitute fabricated/unsupported details per policy. The identification of the most recent order was assumed from the order list order without explicit confirmation, which is less critical but still unverified. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and the final information is not reliably supported by the tools.
